scope: PROMISE BOX UI V1 public static preview only

rules.requirement: Only isolated static assets from docs/ may be published. Production, Railway, server.js, public/, main and existing PRs are outside this task's change scope.
rules.evidence: Git diff review, Pages source configuration and independent review

rules.requirement: Use synthetic identities, conversations and appointments. Do not copy real user data, credentials, production environment variables or production API endpoints.
rules.evidence: Source and fixture review plus tests/ui-static.test.mjs

rules.requirement: Preview browser interactions stay in memory. No network API calls, WebSocket, browser storage, service worker, persistent cache or external calendar mutations.
rules.evidence: Static policy tests, CSP connect-src none and browser request inspection

rules.requirement: AI candidates remain unconfirmed until the user explicitly answers 이대로 확정할까요? with confirm. Edit and ignore must not create an appointment.
rules.evidence: State regression tests and browser flow checks

rules.requirement: A group organizer's confirmation creates the group appointment while each participant's RSVP remains a separate state. Organizer confirmation does not accept for other participants.
rules.evidence: Group confirmation and RSVP regression tests plus browser flow checks

rules.requirement: Render untrusted text through textContent or equivalent text nodes. Do not use HTML string insertion, inline script handlers or executable URLs.
rules.evidence: Static security tests and browser XSS probe

rules.requirement: Use local relative assets and paths that work under a GitHub Pages repository subdirectory. Show a demo notice, version, update time and change history.
rules.evidence: Asset and version tests plus local and published browser checks

rules.requirement: Meet WCAG AA normal-text contrast of 4.5:1 for the tested palette combinations and 3:1 for focus indicators. Verify keyboard, mobile layout, Korean wrapping and control labels in a browser.
rules.evidence: Computed palette tests and recorded browser checks

rules.requirement: GitHub Pages is public. Publish only synthetic static data, retain versioned commits for rollback, and do not treat an unrun test or source review as a browser PASS.
rules.evidence: Deployment report with commit, URL, test results and NOT_RUN fields

rules.requirement: Preserve real incidents and redacted reproduction evidence. Invented incidents belong only in isolated test fixtures. Mark resolved incidents VERIFIED only after regression PASS and an independent review.
rules.evidence: Existing harness validation and incident journal review

rules.requirement: Before publication verify the actual Pages-only environment allows only the exact UI branch in Selected branches and tags mode with zero tags and no secrets or variables. Do not infer the environment policy from the workflow branch or bypass protection. Preserve initial deployment failures and verify actual successful deployment plus the live metadata SHA.
rules.evidence: Actual before/after Pages settings snapshots, scripts/check-pages-environment.mjs, eight guard tests and remote deployment/live visit

paletteContract.constraint: Use ink for normal text on peach and apricot. Muted on these backgrounds, and deep on apricot, fail the normal-text AA threshold. Palette arithmetic alone does not prove every rendered element's contrast.
